title: City that I kept visiting in my dreams for a year and then never again
content: The main entrance of the city had a town hall that also acted as a train station. You’d come out and the first thing you’d see was a giant glowing clock tower covered in Christmas and fairy lights. It was at the very center of this city. The streets were filled with life, and there was an indoor pool near the clock tower that had a waterfall, and it was also a show area as well as a restaurant. I didn’t see the city as far as the first street and clock tower, but I remember the first time I saw it being in a dark and gloomy apartment, and I was looking out the window at the clock tower and glowing city below me.
